description: IDList= carrying a two-item PIDL: My Computer, then the Display control panel applet
notes: The value is a WritePrivateProfileStruct blob -- two uppercase hex digits per byte, then one more byte holding the sum of the data bytes modulo 256. That is the same encoding Modified= uses, which is why its documented 'ninth checksum byte' is a checksum at all.
leak_allow_reason: The long hex run IS the fixture: a hand-built PIDL in WritePrivateProfileStruct encoding. It decodes to a My Computer item and a control panel item and contains nothing from a real machine.
